PhysicalLED.description: Physical LEDs to display status of server.
PhysicalLED.longDescription: This type describes the physical LEDs used to display the status of the server.

^([a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9_]*)?@(odata|Redfis.description: This property shall specify a valid odata or Redfish property.

AmberLED.description: The state of the amber LED.
AmberLED.longDescription: This property shall contain the state of the amber LED indicating critical or non-critical status.

BlueLED.description: The state of the blue identification LED.
BlueLED.longDescription: This property shall contain the state of the blue identification LED.

GreenLED.description: The state of the green LED.
GreenLED.longDescription: This property shall contain the state of the green LED indicating degraded or ok status.

SusackLED.description: The state of the SUSACK LED.
SusackLED.longDescription: This property shall contain the state of the SUSACK LED.
